events.description: Bin Ladin held a press conference indicating the results of his jihad would be visible 'within weeks', directing rhetoric at the US military in Saudi Arabia and the Saudi regime, and claiming near-complete preparations for an attack against the US.
Interview with a US journalist published in which Bin Ladin indicated he may attack a US military passenger aircraft using antiaircraft missiles.
Saudi authorities arrested members of a Bin Ladin network and seized antitank missiles.

key_claims: Bin Ladin indicated in a published interview that he may attack a US military passenger aircraft with antiaircraft missiles.
The risk to US aircraft would be greatest in Saudi Arabia, where Bin Ladin has support and infrastructure.
Saudi authorities arrested members of a Bin Ladin network and seized antitank missiles.
Bin Ladin claimed to have nearly completed preparations for an attack against the US, indicated as occurring in Saudi Arabia or Kuwait.
